_comment: seo-coach auto-summon router for Codex CLI (hooks engine present since ~0.13x). Merge into $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json (default C:/Users/you/.codex/hooks.json or ~/.codex/hooks.json). Event keys are kebab-case here; the wire payload uses PascalCase — the router handles both. Replace <SKILL_DIR> with the folder containing seo_coach_router.py. Codex requires hook trust: the first run prompts you to approve the hook. See README.md in this folder for the verification command.
